name: WF-01 Sales Agent V0 — Synthetic Inbound Loop
description: Normalizes synthetic test-provider inbound events, debounces each provider/channel/contact stream, and orchestrates canonical ingress, one bounded Sales Agent turn, and outbound transcript persistence. This export exists to prove the smallest safe integration edge before any live clinic or provider connection is considered.

nodes.name: Normalize test inbound payload
nodes.notes: Allowlist the synthetic payload at the trust boundary; no business fields are accepted from the provider.

nodes.name: Conversation-scoped debounce buffer
nodes.notes: A bounded process-local POC buffer keyed by provider/channel/contact. Canonical provider_message_id dedupe remains authoritative.

nodes.name: Prepare outbound transport identity
nodes.notes: Create one UUIDv4 per logical outbound intent so transport retries replay the same canonical queue row.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { schema_version: $json.schema_version, provider: $json.provider, channel_account_external_id: $json.channel_account_external_id, provider_message_id: $json.provider_message_id, external_contact_id: $json.external_contact_id, phone_e164: $json.phone_e164, message_type: $json.message_type, text: $json.text, occurred_at: $json.occurred_at } }}

nodes.name: Persist inbound message
nodes.notes: Transport retries reuse the event identity; the backend provider_message_id constraint decides dedupe.

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { provider: 'test', status: 'deduplicated', duplicate: true, conversation_id: $json.conversation_id, message_id: $json.message_id } };

nodes.name: Call Sales Agent turn
nodes.notes: The agent receives only canonical conversation and inbound identifiers; the model never receives provider credentials.

nodes.name: Persist outbound response
nodes.notes: This is canonical transcript persistence. External delivery is intentionally outside the synthetic W4 run.

parameters.jsCode: return { json: { provider: 'test', status: 'accepted', delivery_mode: 'synthetic_only', outbound_id: $json.outbound_id, canonical_status: $json.status, test_result_id: `test-provider-${$json.outbound_id}` } };

nodes.name: Keep scheduled follow-up disabled
nodes.notes: Shape only for W4. No autonomous follow-up or outbound action is enabled.

parameters.content:
### WF-01 boundary

Synthetic/test provider only. The workflow normalizes and transports events; canonical identity, conversation state, availability, booking, handoff and transcript persistence remain in the backend.

The debounce store is process-local and bounded. A restart drops buffered events; transport retry plus backend provider_message_id dedupe make replay safe, but this POC is not a distributed queue.
